candidate_interpretations.description: Individual monitoring-period DMR values must not be compared directly to the limit; compliance requires computing a geometric mean over weekly sub-period samples and comparing that aggregate (or reporting it where limits say Report).

The comment governs only how values are reported on the DMR (geometric mean of weekly values) while numeric limits may still use a different statistic (e.g., 30-day average) for enforcement comparison.
The geometric-mean comment is TDS-specific permit language propagated at limit-set level to unrelated parameters; it does not change comparison semantics for non-TDS limits.
Structured sources do not establish how monthly DMR values relate to weekly geometric means or which aggregation window applies for limit comparison across all partitions.
